whole_body_schedule.contract: Capture point XYZ bits through MOVSS locals, load X/Y/Z on x87; best=FLT_MAX bits7f7fffff, nearest ordinal k=-1, initial head+39 retained for bulk summation.

Eight iterations, five samples each: head, head-1, ..., head-39 using signed IDIV40 remainder. For each sample, XYZ are individually FLD/FSTP binary32, point-minus-sample deltas each binary32, products and sum remain x87 until one binary32 squared-distance spill. Update only for ordered distance<best; first equal minimum wins. NaN/Inf/FLT_MAX-only search can leave k=-1; do not replace it with zero or a validity guard.

For k=0 select younger n=0/older1; for k=39 select n=38/older39. Otherwise compare full3D squared distances to newer neighbor R(k-1) and older R(k+1), each using native binary32 delta/sum stores. newer<=older OR unordered chooses n=k-1; otherwise n=k. Preserve k=-1 exceptional path and actual signed remainder/read schedule. Neighbor selection rereads point Y/Z through native float round trips.

R(j)=record[(head-j+40)%40] under admitted valid head. A=R(n), B=R(n+1). Float-spill A-B XYZ in order, then call the complete registered 0042B260 normalizer on these same three local words, yielding d.

Reload head after normalization. D=float32(A-captured_point), componentwise. Form q=float32(D.x*d.x+D.y*d.y+D.z*d.z) in exact x87 order and duplicate its binary32 image for later residual projection; keep D.z,d.z,D.x,d.x,D.y live on x87.

Start along=q, then add record+10h for ordinals 0 through n INCLUSIVE with a binary32 store after every add. Bulk groups of4 use the initially retained head+39; remainder uses the body reread head schedule. No clamp or sampled/interpolated wake point is called. Negative n skips this sum; negative along is not clamped.

Float-spill c=d.z*D.x-D.z*d.x from the retained x87 stack. First FCOMIP compares0 to c: ordered negative c gives integer -1. Otherwise COMISS(c,+0)/JA gives +1 only for ordered positive; else0, including zero/unordered under masked exceptions. Preserve mixed-instruction behavior and ambient DAZ/exception effects.

Use the original float-spilled q, not accumulated along. Each q*d component is float-spilled separately, then each D minus that product is float-spilled to residual r. This is distance to the winning segment LINE, without projection clamping, and includes Y.

Compute r squared norm using x87 products/sums and a single float spill. Ordered <= binary64 1e-10 OR unordered selects positive-zero magnitude; otherwise call genuine current CRT _CIsqrt through the admitted provider contract and reproduce the native float spill/reload/store sequence.

FILD signed integer sign, multiply by float magnitude and float-store across, then raw MOVSS-store accumulated along. This preserves negative zero where sign=-1 and the magnitude was floored to +0. Native RET12 is not the proposed public Source ABI.

legacy_semantic_discrepancies: ShipAiWakeTrail is a projection with host bookkeeping; written==0 early return and valid flag have no native counterpart.
Legacy steps starts0 instead of native -1; production nearest arithmetic uses SUBSS/MULSS/ADDSS, while native retains x87 products/sums between explicit float stores.
Legacy has no adjacent-neighbor decision; along only sums segments before nearest step. Native selects the winning adjacent line, starts with q and includes segment at younger endpoint.
Legacy calls sample_at_distance_00810630 and measures a chosen horizontal left-normal projection there; native calls no interpolator, uses the winning line and full3D residual magnitude.

Native sign is now resolved as d.z*D.x-D.z*d.x with native comparison/spill rules. It agrees with the geometric left-normal convention when both use the same planar direction, so there is no universal sign inversion claim; changed line/direction and magnitude make the semantic port diverge.
The existing header assertion that the image always clamps off-end along to0 is contradicted by the complete body: q can be negative and no clamp exists.
Native cutoff/unordered path, signed-zero result, exact float round trips, ring read order and output alias schedule must be retained independently of legacy round-trip conventions.
